verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no user-definable rules engine in Paddle for event-triggered actions. Webhooks only push event notifications to your own server, so you would have to build the trigger-action logic yourself. Built-in behaviors don't qualify as user-defined rules either: dunning settings choose what happens to past-due subscriptions, and Paddle auto-creates transactions on lifecycle events, but these are fixed features with narrow configuration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
